messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Portuguese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Portuguese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|----------------------|-----------------------|--------| | Vedi | Imperative command to perceive | Vê | “see” (imperative) | OK | | la | Definite article, fem. sg. | a | “the” (fem.) | OK | | bestia | Noun, fem. sg., the creature | besta | “beast” | OK | | per | Preposition introducing cause | por | “by/for” | OK | | cu' | Relative pronoun “which” (causal) | causa da qual | “cause of which” | OK | | io | 1st sg. personal pronoun, subject | *(omitted)* | *(implicit “I”)* | **MISSING** | | mi | Reflexive pronoun, self‑directed | me | “myself” | OK | | volsi | Past historic of *volgere* “turned” | virei | “I turned” | OK | | aiutami | Imperative “help me” | ajuda‑me | “help me” | OK | | da | Preposition “against” | contra | “against” | OK | | lei | 3rd sg. feminine pronoun “her” | ela | “her” | OK | | famoso | Adjective “famous” | famoso | “famous” | OK | | saggio | Noun “sage” | sábio | “sage” | OK | | ch'ella | Conjunction + pronoun “for she” | pois ela | “because she” | OK | | mi | Pronoun object “me” | me | “me” | OK | | fa | Verb “makes” | faz | “makes” | OK | | tremar | Infinitive “tremble” | tremer | “to tremble” | OK | | le | Definite article, fem. pl. | as | “the” (fem. pl.) | OK | | vene | Noun, fem. pl. “veins” | veias | “veins” | OK | | e | Coordinating conjunction “and” | e | “and” | OK | | i | Definite article, masc. pl. | os | “the” (masc. pl.) | OK | | polsi | Noun, masc. pl. “pulses” | pulsos | “pulses” | OK |

### Items to Review - **MISSING:** *io* – the subject pronoun “I” is not overtly expressed in Portuguese (subject pronoun is optional). - No **WRONG**, **GRAMMAR**, or **UNNECESSARY** items were identified.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Portuguese script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Portuguese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 88: - Original: Vê a besta por causa da qual me virei; - Issue: missing subject pronoun “eu”. - Corrected: **Vê a besta por causa da qual eu me virei;**
